_doc: What each stat does, shown on the Stats & Traits screen. Text only; the numbers are in tuning/career_tuning.tres.

groups.life: Day-to-day wellbeing. Off-field choices and game results move these; each drifts back toward normal every week.
groups.football: Your kicking. Training choices, good kicks and time build these, and they make kicks easier.
groups.personality: Who you are. Changes slowly. Two axes pull against each other: Charisma vs Intelligence, Ambition vs Leadership. High values unlock traits.

stats.health: Low Health adds aim error and raises the weekly injury risk.
stats.energy: Low Energy costs power and adds aim wobble.
stats.fun: Low Fun slows your Resilience gains.
stats.social: Low Social hurts morale under pressure and means fewer invitations.
stats.power: Range: how hard you must flick for a long kick. Also kickoff distance.
stats.accuracy: Less random aim error and wobble, more time to kick.
stats.resilience: How much pressure and a miss streak get to you.
stats.toughness: How much the wind pushes your kicks, and how much injuries hurt.
stats.ambition: Drive to get better and get paid.
